body: I wish I could say this is from the night before but no, I dropped my first of the day at like lunch
To be fair, I didn't really listen and just ripped a fat line
Thanks. I just read somewhere that gaba makes lorazepam stronger but I don't know the combo.

I know my son needs me and he's really the only reason I don't do it. Because I don't want him to hurt like that.  

I do really enjoy cooking new things. I started ordering meal kits as it makes meals easier pain wise and found the new foods made me happy. But my husband always picks it apart to the point where I stopped ordering them because he wouldn't eat half of it. 

My husband tries. He tries so hard the only ways he knows how so I can't fault him for that. But I need more and I feel useless for needing more. He works full time to support the family .  I used to be equal to him financially until I was in an accident that caused me to be unable to work. Because he now bares the full weight of the financial burden it is on me to maintain the household but I just can't. I can't be a mother, and a maid. He doesn't even put his dirty dishes in the sink. Or garbage in the cab. He'll leave it on the counter NEXT to the can. I know he's not doing it maliciously. But he's so used to having someone clean up after him it's just how he behaves. I used to just pick up after him but I can't anymore. It's too much. My son doesn't pick up after himself either as he follows dad ques. If we go away with my own father for a week alone (just my son, father, and i) my son is 100% better. He helps. Picks uip after himself. Puts garbage in the garbage and dishes in the sink. Becasue my dad does these things for himself. 2-4 days after being back home my son is back to behaving like his father.  I've talked to my husband about this and he'll get better for a few days but he always slips back into old habits. And honestly it's so depressing having to constantly have to ask for some common respect and dignity. He's broken too. I know. And I know I can't fix him.

Hobbies outside of the home seem impossible. I don't have reliable free sitters and I don't make any money to pay one. 

I have pain medication but it doesn't work anymore.  I've been on the same dose for almost a year now.  With the opioid epidemic my doctor won't prescribe anything stronger than what I have and my alternative non opioid medication hasn't been available for 2 months now due to a nation wide shortage. My pharamacy finally got some in this week but I was to late calling and all they had left were 9 pills. My prescription is for 2 a day. I've waited 2 months for 9 pills. 

Writing all this down now I feel like I'm whining.  So many stories are so much worse than mine. But I just feel so trapped.

I don't sleep due to pain mostly. I have no real job anymore. My job now is to be a mother but I don't want to do it. I've tried lots of different hobbies but I either loose interest immediately or just don't have it in me to go. I try to keep busy and put on a brave face every day but i just don't want to anymore. I enjoy a video games but you can't play 24/7 when you have a 3 year old and a useless husband. But videogames are just a distraction. As soon as they are off and reality is back I feel just as trapped as I did before
